meta.name: Open Canvas
meta.notes: Charcoal gallery wall stays fixed; --c-primary is reserved for the dock CTA, active filter chips, quick-add hover and the cart (with a light hairline so near-black brands still read); --c-accent only marks small dots and USP icons.

issues: Stats band: giant extended numerals overflow their columns ('3000+' collides with '3', '5500 g' wraps to two lines) on both brands
Catalog H1 breaks mid-word ('assortime / nt') because the 7.6vw extended display size exceeds its grid column
Bestseller row: landscape product photos float as small stamps in tall 4/5 frames with 9% mat, so the section reads empty
Products without an image (Birth Bear gift card) render as a flat grey box with faint initials, which looks like a broken image
Canvas hero ends abruptly at its edges and against the scrolling section; it lacks the gallery depth the art direction asks for
Creativity 7, typography 6.5, layout 6.5, polish 6, brand robustness 7.5, mobile 6.5, generic-ness 7 (signature canvas is genuinely present)
fixed: Stats numerals now size to their own cell via container queries (min(6rem,24cqi)), with a normal-width axis and nowrap, so no value can bleed or wrap
Catalog H1 resized to fit its column (clamp 2.4–6.4rem, 11vw on mobile) and set to hyphenate instead of hard-breaking
Bestseller frames are square with a 6% mat, so mixed landscape photos fill the curated wall
Missing-image placeholder redesigned as an inset gallery mount (hairline border, cross-hatch, dashed inner frame) on both pages
Added a radial gallery vignette and bottom fade over the canvas so the wall dissolves into charcoal, focuses the headline card and flows into the section below
